title: CASE-CANTILEVER-TIP distributed-load ladder: consistent load vector, fixed-end forces and the shear-free end rotation, graded on an Euler-Bernoulli frame and a Timoshenko beam

gates.quantity: symbolic residual of the unit-load re-derivation of all six closed forms
gates.reference: Castigliano: delta = int M m/(EI) + int V v/(kappa G A); rotation with m = 1, v = 0
gates.note: uniform, partial and tip-moment oracles are machine-derived; no handbook digit is copied

gates.quantity: symbolic shear work of the unit-moment rotation under a uniform load
gates.reference: v = dm/dx = 0 for a unit end moment, so theta = q L^3/(6 EI) exactly
gates.note: falsifiable: a model that adds q L/(kappa G A) to the rotation would be wrong

gates.quantity: symbolic residual of V(0)=qL/2, M(0)=M(L)=-qL^2/12 for the clamped-clamped Timoshenko element
gates.reference: exact solution of EI theta''=V, V=kappa G A (w'-theta), V'=-q with four zero end displacements
gates.note: dM/dphi = 0: the Timoshenko element reuses the Euler-Bernoulli load vector

gates.quantity: max relative error of the frame tip deflection vs q L^4/(8 EI), n = 1..8
gates.note: consistent load vector + fixed-end moment q L^2/12 at every mesh, including n = 1

gates.quantity: relative error of the frame tip deflection vs q a^3 (4L - a)/(24 EI)
gates.reference: q a^3 (4L - a)/(24 EI) at a = 0.6 L, conforming mesh (node at a)
gates.note: shear-rigid frame against the bending-only oracle; the load boundary must coincide with a node

gates.quantity: shear share q a^2/(2 kappa G A) / (q a^3 (4L-a)/(24 EI)) of the partial-load case
gates.reference: ratio of the two partial-load oracle terms
gates.note: the frame's mesh-independent offset against the shear-inclusive oracle is exactly this term, so the two oracles must not be mixed

gates.quantity: relative error of the frame tip rotation vs q a^3/(6 EI)
gates.note: nodal rotation of the cubic Hermite field is exact for the cubic exact slope

gates.quantity: max relative error of the frame tip rotation and deflection vs M L/(EI) and M L^2/(2 EI)
gates.reference: pure bending oracle at M = 5 N m
gates.note: constant moment: the Hermite field contains the exact solution

gates.quantity: max relative error of the Timoshenko tip deflection vs qL^4/(8EI)+qL^2/(2 kappa G A), n=1..8
gates.note: new load path (timoshenko_fixed_end_forces); the shear term is 1.0e-4 of the bending term here

gates.quantity: relative error of the Timoshenko tip deflection vs the shear-flexible oracle at L/h = 5
gates.reference: q L^4/(8 EI) + q L^2/(2 kappa G A)
gates.note: the same model is graded where the shear term is 4.2 % of the response

gates.quantity: (delta_TI - delta_EB)/delta_EB for a uniform load at L/h = 5
gates.note: a uniform load separates the theories at a lower slenderness than a tip force does (4.16 % vs 3.12 % at the same L/h)

gates.quantity: relative error of the shear-rigid frame vs the shear-flexible oracle at L/h = 5
gates.reference: q L^4/(8 EI) + q L^2/(2 kappa G A)
gates.note: fail-closed pair with the gate above: a shear-rigid model must not pass where shear matters

gates.quantity: relative error of the tip rotation at L/h = 5, where the shear share of the deflection is 4.2 %
gates.note: the shear-flexible model still returns the shear-free rotation: the symbolic gate, measured

gates.quantity: relative error of the recovered root bending moment (element end forces minus fixed-end forces)
gates.note: exercises the equivalent-load subtraction in solve_frame_static; root shear q L is in the evidence

gates.quantity: relative error when the load boundary falls inside an element (n = 4, patch spread over that element)
gates.reference: q a^3 (4L - a)/(24 EI) with a = 0.6 L (bending-only oracle)
gates.note: measured modelling constraint, not a bug: a partially loaded element is unrepresentable

limitations: the distributed load is per element and full-span, so a load boundary inside an element is not representable; the measured cost of ignoring that is reported (partial_load_boundary_cost) and the conforming mesh is required

both graded models are beam kinematics; the model-free 3-D check of the shear term for a tip-loaded section exists in the sibling anchor fem_cantilever_shear and is not repeated here (no distributed traction on the HEX20 face in this run)
the frame is shear rigid, so it is expected to be rejected at L/h = 5 by the Timoshenko oracle; that rejection is the point of the fail-closed gate pair, not a defect of the element
